title: The "Pawri Hori Hai" Viral Phenomenon
subtitle: Global Cultural Breakthrough
description: A spontaneous 5-second video from Nathiagali goes viral globally across Pakistan, India, and the diaspora, transforming Dananeer into an overnight internet sensation and pop culture icon.

title: Television Acting Debut in "Sinf-e-Aahan"
subtitle: Cast as Syeda Sidra in ISPR Mega-Project
description: Makes her high-profile acting debut alongside top industry stars in Nadeem Baig and Umera Ahmed's military drama Sinf-e-Aahan, earning praise for her natural comedic flair and grounded portrayal.

title: Peshawar Zalmi Brand Ambassador
subtitle: Pakistan Super League (PSL 7)
description: Named official youth and brand ambassador for Peshawar Zalmi in PSL 7, appearing in anthems, fan rallies, and digital youth campaigns.

title: First Solo Lead Role in "Muhabbat Gumshuda Meri"
subtitle: Critical & Commercial Television Triumph
description: Takes center stage as Zobia opposite Khushhal Khan in HUM TV's coming-of-age romance, demonstrating powerful dramatic range and cementing her reputation as an A-list dramatic actress.

title: Lux Style Award — Best Emerging Talent
subtitle: Industry Peer Recognition
description: Wins the prestigious Lux Style Award for Best Emerging Talent in Television, celebrating her transition from digital content creator to recognized television star.

title: Lead in Ramadan Special "Very Filmy"
subtitle: Romantic Comedy Stardom on HUM TV
description: Stars as Sania opposite Ameer Gilani in HUM TV's vibrant Ramadan serial, winning audience hearts with sparkling comedic timing and retro-cinema homages.

title: Digital Expansion & International Brand Campaigns
subtitle: Global Fashion Collaborations & New Productions
description: Continues expanding into premium digital content, YouTube episodic vlogs, and top-tier Pakistani fashion week presentations.
